desc:
Cut through traffic. Outrun the heat. Build your garage.

Welcome to Cut Up, where every gap is a chance to build your combo and every police chase puts your driving to the test. Hit the highways, earn Cash and XP, and work your way toward your next car.

🚔 Escape police pursuits as your wanted level climbs.
🌙 Take on Night Runs and cash out before a bust costs you your earnings.
🚗 Unlock new cars and build a garage that fits your style.
🔧 Customize your ride and dial in your tune.
🏆 Stack clean passes, build bigger combos and climb the leaderboards.
👥 Cruise with friends or see who can keep their run going longest.

One more gap. One more chase. How far can you take it?

Made by Saturn Steering.
👍 Like and favorite Cut Up for more cars and future updates.
